scripts.//order: @ciri/client imports @ciri/codec via the codec's `exports` / `types`, which point at gitignored `./dist/index.*`. npm runs `-ws` in path order (client → codec), so without an explicit pre-step the client's tsc/vitest fails with TS2307 in a fresh checkout. Always build the codec first.
scripts.test: npm -w @ciri/codec run build && npm -ws --if-present run test
scripts.build: npm -w @ciri/codec run build && npm -ws --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @ciri/codec run build && npm -ws --if-present run typecheck
